name: John Cross
quote: NN1 has become the biggest talk of the town in the tech community. At NN1 events, you get to meet others from the region and discover small stories from the real world. It's really friendly; regulars have become friends. We're always ready to welcome new members and network with real people. Each talk is always interesting, sparks thought, and fuels the imagination.  Recommend for everyone in the space.
